texte:
TUNIS, THE ROOFTOP IS CALLING! 🧡

November is flying by, but there’s still plenty of life upstairs!

This week we’re mixing things up: radio sessions, jazz, eclectic sounds, deep house and indie grooves. A different flavour every night, a different reason to drop by.

And with JAOU entering its final week, the festival spirit is still very much in the air. We’re keeping the good times rolling at Habibi, all the way to the closing celebrations. ✨

Bring your friends, find your spot, grab a bite and enjoy the view. The rest will take care of itself. ❤️

🌇 Open from 4PM
🎶 Music from 8PM to 00:30AM
🍴 Food · 🍸 Drinks · 🌃 Rooftop views
✨ Free entry
